questions.stem: Within planarity results, instance 84 — what bound does Euler formula give for simple planar graphs? Answer from the description, and state the conclusion.
questions.explanation: For a simple connected planar graph with n at least 3, Euler formula gives at most 3n-6 edges. The bound 2n-4 applies only when the graph has no triangles.
questions.hint: Derive the bound from V minus E plus F equals 2.
